description: soeru connects ChatGPT to an EC shop's orders, customers, products, brand, and writing voice so the shop owner's AI can draft personalized, on-brand thank-you / packing-slip messages for each order. Read recent orders and per-order context, draft a message in the shop's learned voice, validate it, and save it back to soeru to print on the packing slip. Generation runs in the user's own AI (BYO-AI); soeru does not call an LLM for generation. Writes are draft replacement / save only — no customer-data deletion — and access is scoped to the signed-in user's own shop(s). Supports Rakuten, Shopify, Yahoo! Shopping, and Amazon (Japan).
